input._script:
using Base64, JSON3, Random
const PAYLOAD_B64 = ""
root = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(PAYLOAD_B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
include(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "src", "STADE.jl"))
using CUDA
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
import Atomix
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
cfg = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
names = [String(x) for x in cfg["names"]]
BIGS = [Bool(x) for x in cfg["bigs"]]
# outs: compared arrays; frozen: float scalars that steer a trip count; border: arrays whose border is Dirichlet data
OUTS = Dict("ph_jacobi2d"=>[:u], "ph_cg_laplace2d"=>[:x], "ph_power_iter"=>[:lam], "ph_gs1d"=>[:u], "ph_kepler_newton"=>[:ea], "ph_colebrook"=>[:fric],
            "ph_saha_bisect"=>[:xion], "ph_react_diffuse"=>[:u], "ph_heat_steps"=>[:u], "ph_mg_solve"=>[:u])
FROZEN = Dict("ph_react_diffuse"=>[:kap,:dt,:nu])
BORDER = Dict("ph_jacobi2d"=>[:u,:v,:f], "ph_cg_laplace2d"=>[:x,:b,:r,:p,:ap], "ph_gs1d"=>[:u,:f])
function mk(name, big, rng)
    if name == "ph_jacobi2d"
        nint = big ? 32 : 5; n = nint + 2
        f = zeros(n, n); f[2:n-1, 2:n-1] = randn(rng, nint, nint)
        Dict(:u=>zeros(n,n), :v=>zeros(n,n), :f=>f, :h2=>0.07, :tol=>1e-20, :nint=>nint, :its=>zeros(1))
    elseif name == "ph_cg_laplace2d"
        nint = big ? 32 : 5; n = nint + 2
        b = zeros(n, n); b[2:n-1, 2:n-1] = randn(rng, nint, nint)
        Dict(:x=>zeros(n,n), :b=>b, :r=>zeros(n,n), :p=>zeros(n,n), :ap=>zeros(n,n), :tol=>1e-20, :nint=>nint, :its=>zeros(1))
    elseif name == "ph_power_iter"
        n = big ? 256 : 9
        Dict(:c=>2.0 .+ 2.0 .* rand(rng, n), :x=>fill(1 / sqrt(n), n), :y=>zeros(n), :lam=>zeros(1), :tol=>1e-12, :n=>n, :its=>zeros(1))
    elseif name == "ph_gs1d"
        n = big ? 64 : 12
        f = randn(rng, n); f[1] = 0.0; f[n] = 0.0
        Dict(:u=>zeros(n), :f=>f, :h2=>0.05, :tol=>1e-20, :n=>n, :its=>zeros(1))
    elseif name == "ph_kepler_newton"
        n = big ? 100000 : 6
        Dict(:mean_anom=>2.0 .* rand(rng, n) .+ 0.2, :ecc=>0.1 .+ 0.7 .* rand(rng, n), :ea=>zeros(n), :tol=>1e-14, :n=>n)
    elseif name == "ph_colebrook"
        n = big ? 100000 : 6
        Dict(:re=>10.0 .^ (4 .+ 3 .* rand(rng, n)), :rough=>10.0 .^ (-5 .+ 2 .* rand(rng, n)), :fric=>zeros(n), :tol=>1e-13, :n=>n)
    elseif name == "ph_saha_bisect"
        n = big ? 100000 : 6
        Dict(:s=>10.0 .^ (-1 .+ 2 .* rand(rng, n)), :w=>1.0 .+ 0.5 .* rand(rng, n) .* [1 + 2 * mod(i, 6) for i in 1:n], :xion=>zeros(n), :tol=>1e-9, :n=>n)
    elseif name == "ph_react_diffuse"
        n = big ? 100000 : 9
        Dict(:u0=>0.5 .+ rand(rng, n), :v=>zeros(n), :u=>zeros(n), :kap=>0.8, :dt=>0.3, :nu=>0.2, :tol=>1e-14, :n=>n)
    elseif name == "ph_heat_steps"
        n = big ? 4096 : 10
        Dict(:u=>randn(rng, n), :w=>zeros(n), :wn=>zeros(n), :lam=>0.4, :tol=>1e-20, :n=>n, :nsteps=>3, :its=>zeros(1))
    else  # ph_mg_solve
        L = big ? 12 : 4; nfine = 2^L; nm = nfine - 1
        f = zeros(nm, L); f[:, 1] = randn(rng, nm)
        Dict(:u=>zeros(nm, L), :f=>f, :r=>zeros(nm, L), :nfine=>nfine, :num_levels=>L, :h1=>1.0 / nfine, :nu1=>2, :nu2=>2, :tol=>big ? 1e-12 : 1e-18, :its=>zeros(1))
    end
end
function zborder!(A)
    if A isa AbstractMatrix; A[1,:] .= 0; A[end,:] .= 0; A[:,1] .= 0; A[:,end] .= 0 else A[1] = 0; A[end] = 0 end
    A
end
slice(name, A) = (name == "ph_mg_solve" && A isa AbstractMatrix) ? A[:, 1] : A
relerr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b)) / max(maximum(abs.(b)), 1e-300)
out = Any[]
for name in names
    println(stderr, "KERNEL ", name); flush(stderr)
    primal = STADE.io_read_corpus_entry(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "battle-corpus", name * ".jl"))
    for mode in ("primal", "tangent")
        expr = mode == "primal" ? primal : STADE.stade_tangent(primal)
        fname = expr.args[1].args[1]
        Core.eval(Main, expr)
        plans = Dict{String,Any}()
        fns = Dict{String,Any}(); nk = Dict{String,Int}()
        try
            plans["cuda"] = STADE.stade_gpu(expr, STADE.cgen_backend_cuda()); plans["jacc"] = STADE.stade_jacc(expr)
            for (be, pl) in plans
                for kk in pl.kernels; Core.eval(Main, kk); end
                hasproperty(pl, :helpers) && for h in pl.helpers; Core.eval(Main, h); end
                Core.eval(Main, pl.host)
                fns[be] = getfield(Main, Symbol(fname, "_", be)); nk[be] = length(pl.kernels)
            end
        catch e
            push!(out, Dict("subject"=>name, "mode"=>mode, "status"=>"plan_exception", "msg"=>first(sprint(showerror, e), 300))); continue
        end
        pargs = [Symbol(a) for a in primal.args[1].args[2:end]]
        for big in BIGS
            println(stderr, "  ", mode, " big=", big); flush(stderr)
            vals = mk(name, big, MersenneTwister(7))
            args = Any[]
            for an in expr.args[1].args[2:end]
                s = String(an)
                if haskey(vals, an); push!(args, vals[an])
                else
                    base = Symbol(s[1:end-1]); v = vals[base]
                    if v isa AbstractArray
                        sd = base in (:its,) ? zeros(size(v)) : 0.3 .* ones(size(v)) .+ 0.1 .* rand(MersenneTwister(3), size(v)...)
                        haskey(BORDER, name) && base in BORDER[name] && zborder!(sd)
                        push!(args, sd)
                    else
                        push!(args, (base == :tol || base in get(FROZEN, name, Symbol[])) ? 0.0 : 0.7)
                    end
                end
            end
            ref = deepcopy(args)
            Base.invokelatest(getfield(Main, fname), ref...)              # warm-up and reference
            ref = deepcopy(args)
            t_host = @elapsed Base.invokelatest(getfield(Main, fname), ref...)
            argnames = Symbol[Symbol(a) for a in expr.args[1].args[2:end]]
            itidx = findfirst(==(:its), argnames)
            for be in ("cuda", "jacc")
                try
                    mkdev() = [a isa AbstractArray ? (be == "cuda" ? CUDA.CuArray(copy(a)) : JACC.array(copy(a))) : a for a in args]
                    dev = mkdev(); Base.invokelatest(fns[be], dev...); CUDA.synchronize()      # warm-up (compile)
                    dev = mkdev(); CUDA.synchronize()
                    t_dev = @elapsed (Base.invokelatest(fns[be], dev...); CUDA.synchronize())
                    err = 0.0; changed = 0
                    for (k, an) in enumerate(argnames)
                        s = String(an); base = Symbol(endswith(s, "d") && mode == "tangent" && !(Symbol(s) in pargs) ? s[1:end-1] : s)
                        (base in OUTS[name]) || continue
                        d = slice(name, Array(dev[k])); r = slice(name, ref[k]); a0 = slice(name, args[k])
                        err = max(err, relerr(d, r)); changed += count(d .!= a0)
                    end
                    it_dev = itidx === nothing ? -1 : Int(round(Array(dev[itidx])[1])); it_ref = itidx === nothing ? -1 : Int(round(ref[itidx][1]))
                    push!(out, Dict("subject"=>name, "mode"=>mode, "backend"=>be, "big"=>big, "kernels"=>nk[be], "changed"=>changed,
                                    "status"=>(err < 1e-7 && changed > 0) ? "ok" : "MISMATCH", "max_rel_err"=>err, "t_host"=>t_host, "t_dev"=>t_dev,
                                    "iters_ref"=>it_ref, "iters_dev"=>it_dev))
                catch e
                    push!(out, Dict("subject"=>name, "mode"=>mode, "backend"=>be, "big"=>big, "status"=>"exception", "msg"=>first(sprint(showerror, e), 300)))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("results" => out)))
